fact: Exceeding minimum time set by ECU behind safety car
offence: Breach of Article B5.13.2b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed timing data which showed that Car 11 failed to stay above the minimum time for 2 mini sectors during the SC Deployment and the Stewards determined therefore that the Driver of Car 11 breached Article B5.13.2.b of the 2026 FIA F1 Regulations. The Stewards imposed a 5 second time penalty on Car 11 accordingly.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
